notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Roy Cluse: Itsy-Bitsy Edition has been updated to version 1.2! This topical update adds a new skin and a variety of new graphics.

Here are the patch notes for version 1.2:[list]
[*]Added a new skin: Pandemic
[*]Changed brambles to be more visible
[*]Added several new scenery objects
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1 and upcoming sale
notes.notes:
Roy Cluse: Itsy-Bitsy Edition has been updated to version 1.1! This update adds a new skin, makes the difficulty curve a little gentler, and improves controller support.

Also, Roy Cluse: Itsy-Bitsy Edition will be on sale next week! If you've been thinking about getting the game but haven't yet, this is your chance. We have another small update planned for when the sale starts on Monday.

Here are the patch notes for version 1.1:[list]
[*]Updated engine version
[*]Added a new skin: Hellroy
[*]Reduced the scroll speed of the camera
[*]Reduced the hazard difficulty ramp, which will cause less hazards to spawn in general, but especially early-on
[*]The game will now pause when the Steam Overlay is shown
[*]The mouse pointer will now be hidden while a controller is in use
[*]Changed the "Platformer" achievement to require 500 jumps (from 200). This only affects players that do not have the achievement.
[/list]
